# A lit lantern's light on the water: three flat dashes, 4 cm above the river. A game bone pool. Up Z.
new
material new Shine --base-color 0.8353 0.2353 0.4157 --emission 0.8353 0.2353 0.4157 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name A --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.040
scale 0.700 0.140 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Shine
add mesh cube --name B --size 1 --location 0.100 -0.350 0.040
scale 0.450 0.140 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Shine
add mesh cube --name C --size 1 --location -0.080 0.320 0.040
scale 0.400 0.120 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Shine
select all
active A
join
rename A Shine
shade flat
export shine.glb
